python_mapping.behavior: The source-shaped vcs_evalSS_TP method updates each prepared phase to the solver's stored temperature and pressure, gathers standard chemical potentials in the VCS species order, divides by R*T, and returns VCS_SUCCESS. OLD-state initialization then constructs phase totals, activity coefficients and potentials, solvent-standard concentration terms, species statuses, species free energies, and reaction Gibbs changes.

limitations: Differential coverage is one ideal-gas-plus-graphite state; nonideal and charged phase activity models and independent T/P states are not covered.

This initializes one OLD state and supports one prepared phase-stability call. It does not implement the VCS outer active-set iteration, species deletion/reintroduction, NEW-state iteration, phase birth/death orchestration, or final equilibrium state update.
The exact match is limited to this fixture and does not make the VCS solver complete or certify the current full repository snapshot.
The PyYAML-only mechanism-loading failure is unresolved; the passing fixture test used an environment that also had ruamel.yaml installed.
